summary: The `no_valid_comparison` closure is justified. The authors report effects within cell populations, while HypoExplorer combines all deposited cells within each of six fructose-arm libraries. All five computations reproduced, and all 58 files matched their recorded hashes and sizes. The corrected proposal identifies `geo.html` as a reCAPTCHA page, records access to the preprint and qualifies the cell counts and gene identifiers. It passed the repository proposal validator.
openIssues: The reviewed sources provide no author gene-level effect for the registered all-cell comparison.

The revised Results report 7,244 fructose-arm cells and 13,597 cells across all four arms. Figure S2A labels 19,111 cells. Post-QC barcode membership and library-to-mouse and cage assignments remain unresolved.
Ten neuronal-subtype rows in Table S1 contain unresolved numeric gene identifiers, including six fructose rows.
